conclusion.summary: The formal run observed an original Codex root CA file change 0644 to 0777 during ready finalization after installation strict conservation passed. The 8c Codex policy intentionally still rejects this mode transition. The first control does not meet the baseline-file-exists condition; the owner reports the later full-capture control also did not reproduce it. Private worker-install changes dependency scope and potentially timing but neither changes the certificate policy nor deterministically prevents this earlier baseline condition. There is no proved causal writer or full release fix in the reviewed evidence.
